title: SessionPlayerRace
description: setup for a session of a player and its race

is_bot.description: if true the player is a bot. In this case the user ID must be 'system'

race_id.description: id of the race. If is bot, the race_id should be between 0 and 6

bot_level.description: if is_bot is true, we need a level between 0 and 4

player_order.description: in which slot the player is. ranges from 0 to 15

ready.description: whether the player has marked their race as ready
